direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; single non-wrapping horizontal rail of equal targets with aria-current and arrow-key movement; all targets at least 36px; condense side content inside its reserved zone without overlap
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68); emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D only for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; no label under 12px
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, no route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks visible beside the approved recovery plan while replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to a true 70% scene fill and remove the extra stage logo, preserving only the header logo and the opening-story placement.
Refit empty station and job glyph boxes into legible silver machine bodies at 16px body type, keeping Receiving held and both jobs inside their reserved zones.
Align Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 on shared tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap, and link each bar bidirectionally to its source-evidence card.
Enlarge the SVG scene, shrink empty central space, and raise side-zone body copy to 16px/24 while keeping pre-flight nonce and identity checks visually separate from the investigation evidence task.
Give the route select, Check selected route and Run investigation controls one clear sequence with 2px focus ring, disabled pointer style removed, and aria-live status for check results.
Condense the bottom narration to one instruction and one status sentence inside the reserved side zone at 1366x768.
Make each recovery option a full radio target of at least 36px with visible selected state; selecting it must open the typed consent form rather than relying on the pre-selection primary alone.
Enlarge the scene to 70% and refit the three option cards duplicated at stage bottom so scene options and side-zone options highlight bidirectionally without competing.
Raise tradeoff labels and finish/incremental microcopy contrast, keeping tabular 26px metrics and one primary per viewport.
Restore a dominant factory or capacity visualization to at least 70% of main; the current task cards leave large dead space and lose the cinematic station and job zones.
Clarify the untracked-until-approval state once per zone, reduce repeated proposal text, and keep task targets 1-3 keyboard reachable with neon focus ring.
Show CELL-MILL-1 40h and CELL-MILL-2 24h as reserved station zones linked to the proposed tasks, at 16px minimum.
Strengthen the preview distinction for CELL-MILL-2 going offline with pattern plus text before applying, while reserving full stoppedRed treatment for the actual stopped state.
Enlarge route lines and node labels, remove empty glyph boxes, and keep the feasible neon route from implying passage through the preview-offline cell after invalidation.
Condense side-zone explanation to one instruction and one consequence sentence so the selector and primary fit comfortably at 1366x768.
Apply stoppedRed only to CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; keep its interior dark and ensure no feasible route is drawn through it toward JOB-1002.
Keep pre-flight nonce and identity checks in their own headed zone, separate from the investigation evidence panel, with independent status and controls at 16px.
Enlarge the SVG to fill the reserved scene and raise small route and legend labels to the 12px minimum with patterns and markers, not colour alone.
Give the constrained Split option a non-interactive disabled treatment with pattern and reason text, and ensure the remaining two options open the typed consent form on selection.
Preserve stoppedRed solely on CELL-MILL-2 and show fresh-review-required status in the action bar centre with one primary for the revised option.
Refit empty node boxes into readable machine bodies and enlarge the scene so stations and jobs occupy their independent zones without overlap.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks, the approved revised plan and 3 proposed replacements visibly coexisting, with replacements clearly untracked until approval and not merged into the blocked group.
Apply stoppedRed to the CELL-MILL-2 offline station in the scene and link it bidirectionally to the blocked-task explanation in the side zone.
Reduce repeated proposal wording, enlarge task targets, and add arrow-key movement across tasks 1-3 with a 2px focus ring and reduced-motion support.
Make the three proof stages a clear sequential control set: Verify enabled, Seal locked until verify, Retain locked until seal, each at least 36px with text status beyond colour.
Raise passphrase guidance and field text to 16px, keep one primary per viewport, and announce each completion through aria-live polite.
Enlarge the 01-03 stage cards to use the reserved scene more fully while keeping the side evidence zone independent and non-overlapping.
Confirm completion state is terminal and non-actionable where sealed, removing pointer style from completed Verify and retaining only the intended checkpoint action state.
Keep the final status sentence concise in the action bar centre and ensure the Complete rail item uses aria-current with keyboard access.
Verify no additional logo placement appears in the closing scene; only the header and opening-story placements remain, in immutable black, emerald/neon and brushed silver.
